# Vendored sources

Unmodified snapshots of the repos the notes in `docs/research/` cite, each at the commit the notes pin. Each one is MIT licensed, and its own `LICENSE` file is kept in its folder. Copyright stays with the original authors.

Fetched 2026-11-02 with `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/tarball/<sha>`.
